rules._doc: Each 云栖里 outer-block building must differ on ≥3 axes: height, wall finish, roof, balcony density. Lean CBD/云麓 cream–glass high-end, not identical brick boxes.

axes.wall: plaster p1 · warm w2 masonry strip · glass_strip (window-dominant w1) · glass_podium (shop+glass G)
axes.balcony: none/sparse · mid every-2F · dense every-F · laundry_alt
axes.ac_pipes: none · rare · mid — high-end prefers cleaner facades

rules.avoid: Same floors + same wall variant + same roof + same balcony rhythm as a neighbour within 30 m.
